name: The trusted change, everywhere at once
summary: A change judged safe because of its category or track record skips the staged rollout other changes use, passes a single automated check, and reaches everything at the same moment.
safe_pattern: Send even routine changes through the staged procedure: a small batch first, a human look, then everyone.

conditions.text: The change is treated as routine or already trusted
